newsitem.title: UK: Norway lifts North Sea April oil output - WoodMac.
newsitem.headline: Norway lifts North Sea April oil output - WoodMac.

text.p: Offshore northwest European oil production, excluding Britain, in April increased by 295,000 barrels per day (bpd) from March to average a new high of 3.75 million bpd, industry consultants Wood Mackenzie said on Tuesday.
But total oil output from the North Sea rose by a smaller 252,000 bpd because of a 40,000 bpd fall in output from the UK sector.

Norway was the only regional producer to lift output in April, pumping 299,000 bpd more to average a record 3.5 million bpd largely because of sharp rises at offshore loading fields hit by bad weather in March, WoodMac said.
Danish output fell by about two percent to around 223,000 bpd, as lower production at most fields more than countered first oil from the new Harald field.
Dutch oil output was broadly unchanged at 35,000 bpd, WoodMac said.
